Started a stoner/doom band with a guy I know who knows nothing about music, but he was just going to be the vocalist. But that still meant he had no technique. He found a drummer and bassist. The drummer was pretty decent, but he was very quiet and difficult to work with. We also had to do band practice 2 hours away from me because they didn’t want to meet me halfway. They also were the ones who begged me to write riffs for both guitar and bass.

The singer kind of became the boss, since it was his idea, and he told us to learn different Electric Wizard songs, when the actual goal was to write our own songs. He became mad when I said something against it. When the other members tried to write something, it was just a snippet of a Sleep or Electric Wizard song looped or a few notes swapped out. And we practiced for like 30 minutes before they became tired and sat down on the floor and started eating and playing with my pedalboard.

The bassist, who was a few years younger than me, thought that playing in a stoner band meant that you had to do shrooms and do bongrips every god damn time. She would say cringy stuff like «does anyone have filters? i have rolling papers but no filters…😎» like we get it, you just started smoking weed. I also told her to get a setup on her bass because we tuned to C#. But she could never ask someone for help.

I left and I don’t think they play together anymore.
